````text
# vercel-deploy Skill Documentation

## Installation
```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill vercel-deploy
````

## Core Functionality

This skill enables deploying projects to Vercel without authentication. The process: "Packages your project into a tarball (excludes `node_modules` and `.git`)" then auto-detects the framework and uploads it, returning both a live preview URL and a claim URL for account transfer.

## Basic Command

```bash
bash /mnt/skills/user/vercel-deploy/scripts/deploy.sh [path]
```

**Parameter**: `path` is optional—directory to deploy, a `.tgz` file, or defaults to current directory.

## Usage Examples

- Current directory: `bash /mnt/skills/user/vercel-deploy/scripts/deploy.sh`
- Specific project: `bash /mnt/skills/user/vercel-deploy/scripts/deploy.sh /path/to/project`
- Existing tarball: `bash /mnt/skills/user/vercel-deploy/scripts/deploy.sh /path/to/project.tgz`

## Expected Output

The script provides human-readable confirmation plus JSON data containing `previewUrl`, `claimUrl`, `deploymentId`, and `projectId`.

## Framework Support

Detects from package.json: React frameworks (Next.js, Gatsby, CRA, Remix), Vue variants (Nuxt, Vitepress), Svelte options, frontend tools (Astro, Angular), and backend frameworks (Express, Hono, Fastify, NestJS, etc.). Static HTML projects return framework as `null`.

## Troubleshooting

Network restrictions may block deployment. Solutions include whitelisting `*.vercel.com` in platform settings.
